shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A man in an orange shirt sits in the pinboard-side window seat and asks to review the account from the beginning so every detail is clear. A man in a blue shirt sits in the pinboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a white shirt enters and sits in the entrance-side window seat. A man in an orange shirt asks her to present the evidence, and she agrees to explain the account.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt asks for clarification on the final detail.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the pinboard end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the entrance, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.
